title: Vendor Invoice Audit Computation: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Agency Credit Amount
content:
## Computation of the agency credit

(1) **Days.** The days the agency should have been paid for are the payment's billed days.

(2) **Amount the agency should have been paid.** This is the sum of two parts:
- those days multiplied by the lower of the authorization's recorded daily rate and the option's daily limit, rounded to the cent;
- the charges billed beyond the daily rate. These are the payment amount less its billed days multiplied by its billed daily rate, never below zero, rounded to the cent.

(3) **Agency credit.** The payment amount less the amount in (2). It is never below zero and is rounded to the cent.

The payment examined is the claim's latest agency payment under the Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option. The authorization's recorded daily rate is the rate on the authorization that payment bills.

## Worked audit (hypothetical, Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 40/1200, $40.00 daily limit)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Payment: billed days, billed daily rate, amount | 10 days, $48.00, $495.00 |
| Charges billed beyond the daily rate: $495.00 less 10 multiplied by $48.00 | $15.00 |
| Recorded daily rate on the authorization | $42.00 |
| Lower of $42.00 and the $40.00 daily limit | $40.00 |
| 10 days multiplied by $40.00 | $400.00 |
| Amount the agency should have been paid: $400.00 plus $15.00 | $415.00 |
| Agency credit: $495.00 less $415.00 | $80.00 |

## Second illustration (hypothetical)

A payment of 7 days at $38.00, for $266.00, on an authorization recorded at $38.00 under the same option. The amount the agency should have been paid is 7 multiplied by $38.00, which is $266.00, plus no other charges. The credit is $0.00.
